# Viguru24 — Sovereign & Native Software Suite

> Independent open-source software portfolio by Louis De Souza (GitHub: Viguru24). High-performance, privacy-first native applications for Android, Windows, macOS, and the Web with zero cloud subscriptions or telemetry.

- **Showcase Portal:** https://viguru24.github.io/
- **GitHub Profile:** https://github.com/Viguru24
- **Sitemap:** https://viguru24.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Dedicated App Guides

- [Cosmo Symphony](https://viguru24.github.io/cosmo-symphony/): GPU-accelerated video & photo orchestrator, hardwood framing studio, AI 4K/8K upscaler & local Wi-Fi phone-to-PC sharing built with Rust (Tauri v2) & React.
- [Vixz YouTube Player & Desktop](https://viguru24.github.io/vixz/): Ad-free YouTube clients for Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose / ExoPlayer) and Windows 11 (.NET 9 / WPF) with SponsorBlock, Gemini AI summaries, and offline downloads.
- [CosmoWhisper Native](https://viguru24.github.io/cosmowhisper/): 100% local, offline AI voice dictation and transcription for Windows & macOS powered by OpenAI Whisper (official site: https://cosmowhisper.com).
- [Kin-Tracker](https://viguru24.github.io/kin-tracker/): Privacy-first 24/7 family safety radar & GPS transit network for Android built with OpenStreetMap (Life360 alternative).
- [Cosmo Compendium](https://viguru24.github.io/cosmo-compendium/): Smart tactile recipe & craft formula keeper for Android & iOS with AI scanning & Cook Mode.

## All 19 Public GitHub Repositories

- [Viguru24/Video](https://github.com/Viguru24/Video) (GPL-3.0): Cosmo Symphony — GPU-accelerated video & photo orchestrator, AI upscaler & framing studio (Rust / Tauri v2 / React).
- [Viguru24/YouTube](https://github.com/Viguru24/YouTube) (MIT): Vixz YouTube Player — Ad-free Android YouTube client with SponsorBlock & AI summaries.
- [Viguru24/CosmoWhisper-Native](https://github.com/Viguru24/CosmoWhisper-Native) (GPL-3.0): 100% local AI voice dictation for Windows & macOS (.NET 8 / WPF / Whisper).
- [Viguru24/CosmoWhisper-Downloads](https://github.com/Viguru24/CosmoWhisper-Downloads) (GPL-3.0): Public release binaries and Windows installers for CosmoWhisper.
- [Viguru24/Kin-Tracker](https://github.com/Viguru24/Kin-Tracker) (GPL-3.0): Private 24/7 family safety radar & GPS tracker for Android.
- [Viguru24/VixzDesktop](https://github.com/Viguru24/VixzDesktop) (GPL-3.0): Glassmorphic Windows 11 YouTube desktop player & AI Copilot.
- [Viguru24/cosmo-compendium](https://github.com/Viguru24/cosmo-compendium) (GPL-3.0): Tactile recipe & craft formula keeper for Android & iOS.
- [Viguru24/FluencyAI](https://github.com/Viguru24/FluencyAI) (GPL-3.0): AI-powered English language tutoring Progressive Web App.
- [Viguru24/Video-downloader](https://github.com/Viguru24/Video-downloader) (GPL-3.0): OmniDownloader — Universal video & audio studio PWA.
- [Viguru24/SimpleWhisper-App](https://github.com/Viguru24/SimpleWhisper-App) (MIT): Lightweight Whisper transcription & simulated typing assistant.
- [Viguru24/cosmoscribe](https://github.com/Viguru24/cosmoscribe) (MIT): Local-first AI voice recording & transcription studio (React / SQLite / Whisper).
- [Viguru24/DevControl](https://github.com/Viguru24/DevControl) (MIT): Mission Control desktop dashboard & Zero-Touch HUD for Antigravity (Electron / React).
- [Viguru24/Antigravity](https://github.com/Viguru24/Antigravity) (MIT): Sovereign AI workspace & developer utilities.
- [Viguru24/Viguru24](https://github.com/Viguru24/Viguru24) (MIT): GitHub profile showcase & Quick Download Hub.
- [Viguru24/viguru24.github.io](https://github.com/Viguru24/viguru24.github.io) (MIT): Viguru24 Sovereign Software Suite Showcase Portal.
- [Viguru24/Curriculum-Vitae](https://github.com/Viguru24/Curriculum-Vitae): Louis De Souza — Curriculum Vitae.
- [Viguru24/rotary-club-website](https://github.com/Viguru24/rotary-club-website): Rotary Club of Caterham website & Easter Bunny Fun Run platform.
- [Viguru24/queen-of-clean-demo](https://github.com/Viguru24/queen-of-clean-demo): Queen of Clean London cleaning website showcase.
- [Viguru24/multigravity-pro](https://github.com/Viguru24/multigravity-pro): Multi-profile Antigravity IDE runner (fork).
